about.intro_content: Prof. Zhi-Wei Zhou is Director of the Department of Gastric Surgery at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou, a position he has held since 2009. He has over 30 years of experience in the diagnosis and treatment of gastric cancer and other abdominal malignancies.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Zhou masters open, laparoscopic and robotic surgical techniques for gastric cancer, and his research focuses on neoadjuvant chemotherapy, immunotherapy, chemoradiation and molecular typing of gastric cancer. He has published three editorial books and more than 200 research papers, including a landmark randomised phase 2 trial of perioperative toripalimab plus chemotherapy in locally advanced gastric or gastro-esophageal junction cancer, published in Nature Medicine. He has held leadership roles including President of the Gastric Cancer Specialty Committee of the Guangdong Provincial Anti-Cancer Association and Vice-President of the Gastric Cancer Expert Committee of the Chinese Society of Clinical Oncology.

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. Zhi-Wei Zhou

items.question: Does Prof. Zhi-Wei Zhou accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to gastric cancer at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Zhou's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Zhou specialises in the surgical and multidisciplinary treatment of gastric cancer, including open, laparoscopic and robotic gastrectomy combined with neoadjuvant therapy.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: Is Prof. Zhou involved in clinical trials for gastric cancer?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Zhou co-led a randomised phase 2 trial of perioperative toripalimab plus chemotherapy for locally advanced gastric or gastro-esophageal junction cancer, published in Nature Medicine in 2024.

items.question: Does Prof. Zhou perform robotic gastric cancer surgery?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Zhou is experienced across open, laparoscopic and robotic gastrectomy techniques, tailoring the surgical approach to each patient's disease stage and characteristics.
